现在却作了神的子民；
从前未曾蒙怜恤，现在却蒙了怜恤。
你們從前算不得子民，
現在卻作了神的子民；
從前未曾蒙憐恤，現在卻蒙了憐恤。

In the past you were not a people
but now you are the people of God; then there was no mercy for you
but now mercy has been given to you.

that
as those for whom this world is a strange country
you will keep yourselves from the desires of the flesh which make war against the soul;

因看见你们的好行为，

when you sin
you patiently endure beating? But if
when you do well
you patiently endure suffering
this is commendable with God.

giving you an example
so that you might go in his footsteps:

Last of all
see that you are all in agreement; feeling for one another
loving one another like brothers
full of pity
without pride:
